baseline.state: existing wide Dresser mirror; no Figma plugin panel exists

change_region: Only the new local Figma development plugin panel and the newly inserted PNG rectangle beside a selected Frame.

controls: secondary reset and primary final action
ux.restriction: Controls flow and hierarchy only; the wide desktop rail is not copied into the plugin.

ux.reference: Official Figma Creating a User Interface documentation
controls: recoverable selection, render, and insertion states
ux.restriction: Controls plugin communication and state behavior, not graphical styling.

controls: low-contrast borders and high-contrast final action
ui.restriction: Do not copy the 292 px rail geometry or any proprietary Figma visual asset.

ui.reference: Official Figma showUI theme and sizing contract
ui.restriction: Controls size, density, color tokens, surfaces, and responsive treatment only.

rules: Use named imports only through one typed resolver.
Name every icon-only control and hide decorative icons from assistive technology.
Unknown keys use Question with a development/test diagnostic; never render emoji or a placeholder glyph.

must_preserve: Every current PNG-relevant model, color, background, mesh palette, picture pack, aspect ratio, fixed padding, scale, and position capability.
The existing exact Dresser mirror and browser-backed MCP behavior.
The selected source Frame, its parent, and every unrelated Figma node.
Local-only image privacy and unrelated dirty-worktree changes.
must_change: Add a compact Figma plugin panel for one selected Frame.
Replace the wide desktop rail with one progressive single-column tool flow.
Show exact Dresser PNG preview freshness and recovery states.
Insert the final PNG 80 px beside the source Frame.
structure: 44 px header with Dresser title and concise selection state.
Full-width exact rendered preview near the top.
Scrollable Device, Background, and Layout sections with conditional controls.
Sticky footer with Reset, Update preview, and primary Insert actions.
behavior: One valid Frame triggers bounded PNG export and an initial exact preview.
Control changes mark the preview stale; Update refreshes it, while Insert refreshes first when stale.
No, multiple, non-Frame, stale, or removed selection prevents insertion and explains recovery.
Errors preserve the last valid preview and source context and expose a retry.
Successful insertion selects the new named PNG node beside the unchanged source.
responsive: Default target is 360x640 with one vertical scroll region and no horizontal clipping.
Approved expanded target is 420x720; preview may grow but hierarchy and footer remain stable.
Widths below 320 px and mobile/touch adaptation are outside this local Figma Desktop MVP.
content: Use Dresser as the plugin name.
Use concise labels: Model, Color, Background, Layout, Padding, Scale, Horizontal, Vertical, Reset, Update preview, Insert beside frame.
No-selection message: Select one Frame in Figma.
Never surface or persist a local path, token, raw payload, or unrelated document content.

visual_details.panel: Figma theme CSS variables with Dresser-dark fallback
visual_details.surface: subtle neutral elevations with one-pixel low-contrast separators
visual_details.accent: one high-contrast primary Insert action; preview pixels are never recolored
visual_details.radius: 6-8 px controls and 10 px preview shell
visual_details.focus: 2 px visible high-contrast outline with offset
visual_details.motion: 120-180 ms state feedback only; honor prefers-reduced-motion

acceptance: At 360x640, preview and primary Insert action remain immediately legible while all settings are reachable in one scroll column.
The panel reads as Dresser adapted to a Figma tool window, not a squeezed copy of the wide browser editor.
Every conditional state has a stable location and does not shift the sticky footer off screen.
Light and dark host themes preserve contrast, focus, and the original rendered preview.
The exact final preview and inserted image agree, and the source Frame remains unchanged.
Icon geometry, accessible names, and fallback behavior are consistent.
known_debt: Mobbin MCP is unavailable; no stable Mobbin reference or durable provider asset exists, and this must remain visible in approval evidence.
The first demo depends on a local token-protected browser companion and is not yet a self-contained Figma Community package.
Batch, video, editable output, remote rendering, and plugin publication are deferred.
